## What it is

Couvercle du boîtier à quatre Wago (`boitier_4w`). Impression tête en bas : face extérieure sur le plateau, jupe en +Z. Deux vis M3 dans les piliers du boîtier.

## Design notes

The plate is 1.6 mm and sits on the box walls, closing the four open-top slots from above. A 2.5 mm skirt nests on the three walls that have no wire slots (back and both ends). The slotted wall stays clear so the dropped-in wires are not pinched.

Hold-down: three murets on the box divider lines plus a full-width front stop bar just past the Wago depth (`wago_y + jeu_wago`), jupe height — same commercial Wago-lid pattern as `couvercle_2w`.

Same inner 37 × 32 mm and 1.6 mm walls as `boitier_4w`. Prefer 3MF export (`nurb export`); Studio may warn on nurb 1.41.

## Don't

- Do not align lid ribs with the floor rails. They face the bay murets and separate the Wagos.
- Do not run a full-perimeter skirt. Slots in the jupe at the notched wall left 0.05–0.12 mm films.
- Do not U-cut or slot the skirt for the wires; omit the jupe on the slotted wall instead.
- Do not polish inner skirt edges. Same rule as the box: outer corners only.
- Do not change the lid holes to M4. Clearance is ISO 273 medium for M3 (3.4 mm).

## Changelog

- Hold-down murets on divider lines + front stop bar (reference Wago lid).
- Renamed from `couvercle` to `couvercle_4w` with the two-Wago sibling.
- Lid for the four standing 221-423 box. XY unchanged when the box went to 25 mm; reprint the box, not this lid, after that height change.
